name: short-term-api-contract
description: OpenAPI contract and deployment tooling for the campus second-hand marketplace MVP

scripts.openapi:bundle: redocly bundle campus-market@v1 --output openapi/openapi.bundle.json --ext json --remove-unused-components --component-renaming-conflicts-severity error
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:config && npm run openapi:lint && npm run openapi:bundle && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/openapi.bundle.json
